title: Race Cars Zoom Past Washington Monuments!
summary:
Have you ever seen a race car zoom by a big monument? On Sunday, that's happening in Washington, D.C.! The city is hosting an IndyCar race called the Freedom 250 Grand Prix. Cars will speed through the streets at almost 200 miles per hour! That's faster than a jet airplane takes off.

President Donald Trump and his wife, Melania, will be there. They will watch from the side of the road. Before the race, they will ride in the presidential limousine. That's a special car that the president uses.

This race is part of a big birthday party. America is turning 250 years old this year! The president has been celebrating with lots of events. He had a fireworks show on the National Mall. He also had a UFC fight on the White House lawn. Now, he's adding a car race!

Some people dress up like old presidents. You might see someone dressed as Thomas Jefferson or Abraham Lincoln at the race.

The race is not just for fun. It's also to show off how powerful America is. The president said, "Their beautiful cars are going to make freedom roar." That means the cars will make a loud noise, like freedom is roaring!

But not everyone is happy. Some people think the president should be focusing on other things, like the war with Iran. That war has made gas prices go up. But for now, the president is enjoying the race.

The race is paid for by a friend of the president, Roger Penske. He owns the IndyCar series. He is paying for most of the race, including building the track.

So, if you like fast cars and big celebrations, this is a big deal. It's a race through the heart of America's capital city!
why_it_matters: When your family or town celebrates something big, this story shows that celebrations can be fun but also make people argue about what leaders should focus on.
